scientific_integrity: Analytic proof with standalone reproducible consistency checks; finite calculations are supplementary and independent review has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-dimensional directed two-community logistic threshold quotient only. No generalization to noisy finite-agent observations, unequitable initial conditions, heterogeneous thresholds, or a nonlinear stability claim at the nonhyperbolic boundary. Originality is based on searched primary literature and requires independent priority confirmation.
title: Sharp polarization envelope and inverse asymmetric mixing in two-community logistic threshold networks
